units.source_text: 课间，我马上拽住柏木的胳膊。

en.t: During the break, I immediately grabbed Kashiwagi by the arm.

units.source_text: 对我来说，这种快活的动作已是属于罕见的行为了。

en.t: For me, such a cheerful action had already become a rare thing.

units.source_text: 他歪了歪嘴角笑着陪我走到走廊上。

en.t: He twisted the corner of his mouth into a smile and walked with me out into the corridor.
